comment: The service-health registry that intelligence_hub/status.py reads. Every endpoint is an official, free, machine-readable status source that answered on probed_at. cors records whether the endpoint sent Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a browser origin on that date. Only Statuspage-format status endpoints with cors true are read by the visitor's browser, and the connect-src list in site/index.html names exactly their hosts. desk is the desk the source's incident rows sit on in the Explorer (always infrastructure). page_only lists vendors with no machine-readable status source: they are linked and never polled. docs/SOURCES.md describes every field.
